name: Kazato Asa
source: Asa is a girl with a bright and warm atmosphere. She can be a little clumsy, and a bit of an airhead but even those values are attractive. Asa, who can get along with anyone, helps others get along with each other as well. With her sister Yoru, they provide their secret base as a garage for the glider.
